audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagreed with its own why. whys[0] says level 1 is even (row read Wukong), whys[1] 'favours you' (row read Skill), whys[2] and whys[3] say the lane stays yours (rows read Tahm Kench), whys[4] calls 6 his one edge (row read Wukong), whys[5] and whys[6] say you stay ahead (rows read Tahm Kench).
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Tahm Kench, Wukong, Wukong] and matches the whys line for line — only the stored sides were wrong.
audit.corrected: All seven rows realigned in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was described as 'roam pressure' via Abyssal Dive. Level 6 gives him Devour — the ability that eats you — and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Kit: Tongue Lash (Q) 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s at 900 range, Abyssal Dive (W) 21/20/19/18/17s, Thick Skin (E) 3s, Devour (R) no cooldown of its own but 100 mana and gated behind three An Acquired Taste stacks.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten around Devour and the three-stack gate; Abyssal Dive given its 21s, Tongue Lash its 7s and 900 range, Thick Skin named at 3s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two abilities are swapped on the page: Abyssal Dive is called '(R)' and Devour is called '(W)' / '(W self-cast)', in exactly the lines that carry the level-6 and late-game plans. Abyssal Dive is also called 'his escape + shield' — it is a W dive that knocks up, he has no escape, and the shield is Thick Skin. Finally the three-stack gate on Devour was never stated, which is the actual counterplay.
audit.why: Riot text — W: 'Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.' E: 'Passive: stores a percent of the damage he takes... Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.' R: 'devours a champion for a few seconds.' P: 'At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.'
audit.corrected: Slots corrected in five strings, Thick Skin named as the shield, Abyssal Dive described as a knockup engage he cannot escape with, and the three-stack gate written in as the thing to deny.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tahm Kench's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Devour is his R, not his W: at three An Acquired Taste stacks he can eat you or an ally — count the stacks before you commit.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His escape + shield. Burst when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abyssal Dive (W): 21s at rank 1 — a knockup engage, not an escape. - Tongue Lash: 7s, 900 range, and the third stack stuns. - Thick Skin (E): 3s, and it converts stored damage into a temporary shield.

edits.before: His escape + shield. Burst when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is a 21s knockup engage, not an escape — he has no dash and cannot leave your E.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thick Skin turns the damage you dealt back into a shield every 3s.

edits.before: Track Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive: His escape + shield. Burst when down. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive (W) is a 21s knockup engage; Devour is his R and needs three stacks. E-Q him between them.

edits.before: Tahm's Abyssal Dive (R) is a roam/gank tool, not a duel spike, so this is his one lane edge only if a jungler collapses with it — solo, your Cyclone all-in still beats him. Watch the map when he hits 6 and keep W ready to dodge the emergence stun.
edits.after: Tahm's level 6 is Devour (R), not map presence: at three An Acquired Taste stacks he can eat you outright. Deny the stacks and his 6 does nothing — solo, your Cyclone all-in still beats him. Abyssal Dive (W) is the 21s knockup engage.

edits.before: Post-first-item you stay ahead: Tahm's Devour (W self-cast) gives him a survival cooldown but no kill pressure, and his grey health pops if you keep DPS on him. Keep shoving and deny his roam value with prio.
edits.after: Post-first-item you stay ahead: Thick Skin (E) gives him a shield off stored damage but no kill pressure, and that grey health pops if you keep DPS on him. Keep shoving and deny his roam value with prio.

edits.before: Tahm shifts to a peel/save tank who Devours his carries out of your dive; hold your R knockup to catch him or his backline after his W is spent, and beware his ally-eat saving your target.
edits.after: Tahm shifts to a peel/save tank who Devours his carries out of your dive; hold your R knockup to catch him or his backline after Devour (R) is spent, and beware his ally-eat saving your target.

edits.before: Roam with Abyssal Dive (R) for a jungle collapse
edits.after: Roam with Abyssal Dive (W) for a jungle collapse

edits.before: Devour (W) an ally out of your all-in
edits.after: Devour (R) an ally out of your all-in

notes: The packet reports zero defects and zero suspectNames here, yet this page had the worst error in the slice: correct ability names attached to the wrong slot letters, which no name-distance check can catch. Worth adding a slot-vs-name cross-check to the validator — the mirror audit reached the same conclusion independently. Devour's cooldown reads 0 in the kit because the gate is the three-stack passive and 100 mana, so I wrote the gate rather than a number.
